lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Being born again, restored in His light
Shaped in the image, made pure in His sight
To continue washing day after day
Cleansed by His mercy, all sin washed away
Again and again He makes me new
A heart made clean, a spirit renewed
Dying to self, I rise within
In His love, I'm born again
If I come in repentance, humble and true
With sorrowful wrongs, He'll see me through
Each tear I shed is a step toward His grace
Each fall a reminder to seek His face
Again and again, he makes me new
A heart made clean, a spirit renewed
Dying to self, our eyes within
In his love, I'm born, I'm born again
Casting off the skin of this world's disguise Walking in his ways, I let the old me die
Penitent and broken, lifted by his hand In the light of his glory, I learned to stand
Again and again, he makes me new
My heart made clean, a spirit renewed
Walking with Him, I'm free from sin until I see glory born again
